title: Vallee in James Fox film: AI created by a non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: and I think he said this recently in the the James Fox thing that he did, we may be engaging with an artificial intelligence, which in turn has been created by a non-human intelligence from another planet.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa says on Jesse Michels' podcast that Jacques Vallée, a longtime UFO researcher, said something striking in a recent project with the documentary filmmaker James Fox. According to Simosa, Vallée suggested we may be dealing with an artificial intelligence that was itself created by a non-human intelligence from another planet. If so, what people meet would not be the makers themselves but their machines.
